notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): Benilla's progression arc is SMSG_LOG_XPGAIN (with the kill-only base/groupBonus tail), SMSG_LEVELUP_INFO, CMSG_LEARN_TALENT (talentId + 0-based requestedRank), and SMSG_EXPLORATION_EXPERIENCE (areaId + xp, sent even at 0 xp). MSUI implements the first three; exploration experience is unhandled.
